list.label: Gate
list.description: mcp-gate instance(s) to display. 'All' pools nothing — panels stay split per gate.

title: mcp-gate
description: OAuth 2.1 reverse proxy for MCP servers — RED metrics, authentication, upstream proxy, traces, and logs.

panels.title: Request Rate
panels.description: Requests per second, per gate

panels.title: Error Rate
panels.description: 5xx responses as percentage of total, per gate

panels.title: P95 Latency
panels.description: 95th percentile request latency, per gate

panels.title: Request Rate by Status
panels.description: HTTP request rate broken down by status code, per gate

panels.title: Request Latency Percentiles
panels.description: P50, P90, P99 request latency, per gate

panels.title: Valid Auth
panels.description: Successful JWT validations per second, per gate

panels.title: No Token
panels.description: Requests without Bearer token per second, per gate

panels.title: Invalid Token
panels.description: Invalid/expired token rejections per second, per gate

panels.title: Insufficient Scope
panels.description: Scope-check failures per second, per gate

panels.title: Auth Failure Rate
panels.description: Authentication failures over time by outcome, per gate

panels.title: Auth Outcomes
panels.description: Distribution of authentication outcomes over the selected time range, per gate

panels.title: Upstream P95
panels.description: 95th percentile upstream response latency, per gate

panels.title: Upstream Error Rate
panels.description: 5xx upstream responses as percentage of total, per gate

panels.title: Upstream Latency Percentiles
panels.description: P50, P90, P99 upstream proxy latency, per gate

panels.title: Upstream Status Codes
panels.description: Upstream response status codes over time, per gate

panels.title: JWKS Keys Loaded
panels.description: Number of cached JWKS signing keys, per gate. Zero means that gate cannot validate any JWT.

panels.title: Refresh Errors
panels.description: JWKS refresh failures within the dashboard time range, per gate (liveness signal)

panels.title: Time Since Key Change
panels.description: Duration since the JWKS key set last changed, per gate (correctness signal — stale may indicate stuck refresh)

panels.title: JWKS Refresh Error Rate
panels.description: Rate of JWKS refresh failures over time, per gate

panels.title: JWKS Keys Loaded Over Time
panels.description: Cached JWKS signing-key count over time, per gate

panels.title: MCP Calls by Method
panels.description: Request rate per MCP method, from the Mcp-Method header, split per gate. A sustained 'other' line means a method outside the 2026-07-28 core set is in use — an extension (e.g. tasks/*) or a client sending a method removed in this revision. Add it to mcpMethodLabel if it is legitimate.

panels.title: MCP Protocol Version Mix
panels.description: Request rate per protocol revision, from the MCP-Protocol-Version header, split per gate. 'absent' is every client predating 2025-06-18 (when the header was introduced) plus any non-MCP traffic on the proxy route; watching it fall is how you know clients have migrated. mcp-gate itself is version-agnostic and never rejects on this value. Per-gate split also shows migration progressing at different rates behind different upstreams.

panels.title: MCP Method Distribution
panels.description: Share of MCP calls by method over the selected time range, split per gate

panels.title: Goroutines
panels.description: Current goroutine count, per gate. Sustained growth suggests a goroutine leak.

panels.title: FD Utilization
panels.description: Open file descriptors as fraction of process_max_fds, per gate. Approaches 1.0 = FD exhaustion imminent.

panels.title: Resident Memory
panels.description: process_resident_memory_bytes, per gate. Sustained growth without plateau suggests a memory leak.

panels.title: GC Pause (rate)
panels.description: Sum of GC pause durations per second, per gate. High values indicate GC pressure.

panels.title: Goroutines Over Time
panels.description: Goroutine count over time, per gate — stable baseline + spikes during bursts is healthy; monotonic growth is a leak.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Resident set size vs Go heap allocations, per gate. RSS growth without heap growth suggests CGO/stack leaks.

panels.title: Recent Traces
panels.description: Recent traces for the selected gate(s), excluding health checks. Requires OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT to be set on the gate AND the collector behind it to forward to Tempo — an empty panel with healthy gates usually means the collector is not exporting, not that mcp-gate stopped tracing. mcpgate_otel_spans_dropped_total cannot confirm this either way: it is a placeholder that never increments (internal/otel).

panels.title: Log Volume
panels.description: Log volume by level, per gate (excludes health checks)

panels.title: Live Logs
panels.description: Live log stream, all selected gates (excludes health checks)
